## MMM_RIDGE_HELDOUT_GEO_TIME_NUISANCE_SENSITIVITY_CERTIFICATION_001 (in progress)

Evidence work completed on the declared branch with five deterministic H6 worlds. Candidates A
(global Ridge), B (known-geo effects), and C (known-geo plus bounded Fourier/trend) use a 0:39
training / 39:52 holdout boundary, training-only fitted transforms and coefficients, full-path
recursive state, independent `transform_truth`/`true_beta_gc` truth, and a fixed +10% holdout
intervention. Repeated Docker runs with `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` were byte-identical. Results show B/C
improve held-out residual fit and serial/geo pattern diagnostics but Delta-mu remains materially
under-recovered in four of five worlds and pooled-beta error remains large; omitted nuisance is
not the sole mechanism. No production behavior or authority changed.

Evidence: `docs/05_validation/mmm_ridge_heldout_geo_time_nuisance_sensitivity_certification_001.md`
and its JSON archive. Validation: deterministic reproduction twice/byte equality; focused H6/Ridge
tests `26 passed`; JSON parse; documentation links (`169` files, informational orphan list);
`python -m mmm.execution.taskctl check`; `git diff --check`; and Docker `make validate` (`100%`
tests passed; pre-existing lint warnings only). The generated diagnostics archive touched by the
